prompt: Name a figure from Norse mythology
qualifiers: gods, giants, creatures, places and treasures

answers.name: Loki
answers.fact: A shape-shifter who gave birth to an eight-legged horse.

answers.name: Freya
answers.fact: Rides a chariot pulled by cats.

answers.name: Valhalla
answers.fact: The hall where Odin's chosen dead feast.

answers.name: Mjölnir
answers.fact: Thor's hammer, forged by two dwarves.

answers.name: Frigg
answers.fact: Odin's wife; Friday may be named after her.

answers.name: Baldur
answers.fact: Killed by a dart of mistletoe.

answers.name: Tyr
answers.fact: Lost a hand to the wolf Fenrir; Tuesday is named after him.

answers.name: Freyr
answers.fact: Owns a ship that folds into a pocket.

answers.name: Njord
answers.fact: God of the sea and wind.

answers.name: Hel
answers.fact: Rules the land of the dead.

answers.name: Fenrir
answers.fact: A giant wolf who will swallow Odin.

answers.name: Jörmungandr
answers.fact: A serpent that circles the whole world.

answers.name: Niflheim
answers.fact: A world of ice and mist.

answers.name: Ymir
answers.fact: The first giant; the world was made from his body.

answers.name: Surtr
answers.fact: A fire giant who will burn the world.

answers.name: Mimir
answers.fact: A wise head kept by Odin.

answers.name: Hodr
answers.fact: The blind god tricked into killing Baldur.

answers.name: Skadi
answers.fact: A giantess of winter and skiing.

answers.name: Aegir
answers.fact: A sea giant who brews ale for the gods.

answers.name: Ran
answers.fact: Catches drowned sailors in her net.

answers.name: Kvasir
answers.fact: The wisest being, whose blood became the mead of poetry.

answers.name: Draupnir

answers.name: Nidhogg

answers.name: Thrym
answers.fact: A giant who stole Thor's hammer.

answers.name: Garmr
answers.fact: A blood-stained hound at Hel's gate.

answers.name: Sól
answers.fact: Goddess of the sun, chased by a wolf.

answers.name: Gefjon
answers.fact: Ploughed the island of Zealand out of Sweden.

answers.name: Hermod
answers.fact: Rode to Hel to bring Baldur back.

answers.name: Andvari
answers.fact: A dwarf with a cursed ring.

answers.name: Fafnir
answers.fact: A dwarf who became a dragon.

answers.name: Audhumla
answers.fact: A primeval cow who licked the first god out of ice.

answers.name: Buri
answers.fact: The first god, licked from the ice.

answers.name: Hati and Sköll
answers.fact: Wolves chasing the sun and moon.

answers.name: Naglfar
answers.fact: A ship made of dead men's nails.

answers.name: Hlidskjalf

answers.name: Hrimfaxi
